newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Quake off Indonesia's Ambon wakes residents.
newsitem.headline: Quake off Indonesia's Ambon wakes residents.

text.p: An earthquake measuring 6.0 on the open-ended Richter scale shook Ambon in eastern Indonesia, waking residents but apparently not causing major damage, the Metereological and Geophysics Office said.
A geophysics section official said the earthquake, centred in the Banda Sea about 20 km (12 miles) south of Ambon city, struck at 3.41 a.m. on Tuesday (1941 GMT on Monday).
"It was felt in Ambon (on the island of the same name). So far we have no reports of damage," the official in Jakarta, 2,400 km (1,488 miles) southwest of Ambon, said.
Police and officials on Ambon were not immediately available. However a resident in Ambon city said the earthquake was large enough to wake most residents.
"The tremors were very big, but there does not appear to be any damage to the city and I have not heard of any victims," the resident told Reuters by telephone.
